intro: Deviation settlement leads this edition. CERC has held that its powers to relax and remove difficulty under the DSM Regulations, 2024 cannot create a new generator category, so a 160 MW blended wind project stays in the tighter hybrid band. It has also deferred reserve-shortfall recovery of DAS Pool deficits to April 2027. In Uttar Pradesh, UPERC has cleared NPCL's 300 MW round-the-clock RE tender, allowing the whole capacity to go to one L1 bidder and limiting bidding to holders of a final connectivity grant. Also included: CERC's proposal to admit pumped storage to the HP-DAM, SJVN's ₹4.82–4.91/kWh FDRE tariffs for 448 MW, an ISTS waiver limited to commissioned capacity, and short-term RTC bagasse power at ₹5.10–5.12/kWh for NIDP.
